github.description: GitHub MCP server — PRs, issues, files, checks, code search. Uses GitHub's hosted HTTP transport (no local install).
github.notes: Token needs classic PAT 'repo' scope (private repos) or the fine-grained equivalents for the resources you want (Pull requests: read/write, Issues: read/write, Contents: read, Actions: read). Create one at https://github.com/settings/tokens. ${VAR} expansion in MCP headers can be unreliable across Claude Code versions — if the server rejects auth, fall back to pre-resolving the header in the shell when registering: claude mcp add --scope <scope> --transport http github https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ --header "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN".

mcp-atlassian.notes: Cloud (atlassian.net): set JIRA_USERNAME + JIRA_API_TOKEN. Create the token at https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens. Server / Data Center: set JIRA_PERSONAL_TOKEN (Personal Access Token from your Jira profile). Install uvx via 'curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh'.
